answer: Anti-sybil here is a bonded incremental-cost gate: each new identity must lock a copper stake equal to the 21-day work-output delta versus the median of already-established peers, then present that bond at a public mesa checkpoint that also binds a hardware fingerprint and a 72-hour cooldown clock. A sockpuppet farm pays the full bond plus lockup opportunity cost for every clone; a fingerprint collision or missed cooldown slashes the bond with no refund, so extra identities scale linearly in scarce capital rather than appearing for free.
